items.question: Does the viewer commit to a wrong answer before hearing the right one?
items.note: independent critic, two rounds: The viewer commits to the moral ('Find a price that works, and don't touch it') at THE QUESTION, restated at THE CATHEDRAL before the reveal; second round's leaks fixed: the 'it's a memory' line moved to the reveal, hook 3 ends on a question.

items.question: Is there a concrete number in the first sentence?
Is the title's promise fully delivered?
items.note: independent critic, two rounds: The title promises what the ceiling never told them; WHAT THE DIME TAUGHT and the close deliver it. 'More than 50 years' (1880 to 1932, eastern stores) is qualified in the narration.

items.question: Does any notation appear before its intuition?
items.note: independent critic, two rounds: Second round failed it on the minus-one rule and the standard error arriving without meaning; fixed: WHY A RAISE explains the slopes above and below minus one before the method, and THE HONEST RANGE says what the standard error and the multiplier are before the method uses them.

items.question: Is there exactly one idea, and exactly one CTA?
items.note: 1 CTA beat(s); one idea: A held price is unmeasured, and only movement reveals demand. Hook 2 now ends on the held price, and the soap-and-skimmer beat turns toward different best prices instead of a second task.

items.question: Does the CTA match the awareness stage in §8?
Is there one claim a competent operator could dispute?
items.note: independent critic, two rounds: 'A price you've never moved isn't a safe price. It's an unmeasured one' and 'waiting with the price held still adds nothing' are disputable; the film takes the price-stability objection on at WHEN THE PRICE IS THE BRAND.

items.question: Is there any gap over 40 seconds without a re-hook?
Does every number name its model run?
items.note: every chart beat names its run; every key exists

items.question: Is any step of the method withheld?
items.note: independent critic, two rounds: Every step the course teaches is in the method (units a day, exclusions, the 2% spread rule, the log fit and its range, the minus-one rule as the engine applies it, the best-price formula at the estimate and both ends, the 5% cap, the written prediction), plus lesson 7's watch-and-reverse while the step is live.

items.question: Does the close state a real limitation rather than pitch?
items.note: independent critic, two rounds: Real limits (seasons, ads, reactive pricing, competitors, cannibalisation, thin history, sizing the step) and the soft close word for word, no product named; the film now ends on the close.

items.question: Are CLIP markers placed, with at least three usable?
Would a $30M founder outside Amazon still get something from this? (pillars 1–2 exempt)
items.note: independent critic, two rounds: Elasticity, contribution, the hill and testing in time apply to any seller; fees are described generically and the demo is labelled.
